specification.name: filter
specification.summary: Acknowledges all records that get passed to the filter.
specification.description:
Acknowledges all records that get passed to the filter, so
the records will be filtered out if the condition provided to the processor is
evaluated to `true`.

**Important:** Make sure to add a [condition](https://conduitdata.io/docs/using/processors/conditions)
to this processor, otherwise all records will be filtered out.
specification.author: Meroxa, Inc.

sdk.schema.decode.key.enabled.description: Whether to decode the record key using its corresponding schema from the schema registry.

sdk.schema.decode.payload.enabled.description: Whether to decode the record payload using its corresponding schema from the schema registry.

sdk.schema.encode.key.enabled.description: Whether to encode the record key using its corresponding schema from the schema registry.

sdk.schema.encode.key.strategy.description: How to build a new key schema when the processed key no longer fits the schema the record carried. "infer" extracts a schema from the values (Avro int becomes long, date becomes timestamp-micros, decimals become decimal(31,10)). "extend" keeps the carried type of every field still present, adds new top-level fields as nullable with a null default, leaves out removed top-level fields, and fails the record if a value does not fit its carried type.

sdk.schema.encode.payload.enabled.description: Whether to encode the record payload using its corresponding schema from the schema registry.

sdk.schema.encode.payload.strategy.description: How to build a new payload schema when the processed payload no longer fits the schema the record carried. "infer" extracts a schema from the values (Avro int becomes long, date becomes timestamp-micros, decimals become decimal(31,10)). "extend" keeps the carried type of every field still present, adds new top-level fields as nullable with a null default, leaves out removed top-level fields, and fails the record if a value does not fit its carried type.
